title: Pure Atlantis Umi
aliases: Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
summary: The page's Atlantis Umi build: the eleven Atlantis and Daedalus cards from Beyond the Brave, the classic Umi cards that still pull their weight, and generic interaction. It plays the page's combo lines, and the Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon page opens this same list. Most of the new monsters count as "Umi" on the field, which keeps Kairyu-Shin's lock and Electric Jellyfish's negate on after the Field Spell is gone. Warchief and Call of Atlantis search the engine, Advent places the Field Spell, and Neo-Daedalus Rage sends every card on the field to the GY except your "Umi". The only other outside cards are Dominus Impulse, Marincess Coral Anemone and Mediclius, all from the page's build.

allow.Dominus Impulse: In the page's build: its lock stops LIGHT, EARTH and WIND monsters, and this deck is all WATER.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Generic WATER Link-2 in the page's Extra Deck: revives Siren Vortex or Monster Arms.
allow.Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron: WATER Link-3 in the page's Extra Deck, made from a Daedalus Link and two more monsters.

main: Levia-Dragon of Atlantis - Daedalus
Newest support. Summons itself with Umi or Atlantis out; sends Umi cards to search that many Atlantis cards, then sends a card on the field to the GY.
Warchief of Atlantis
Newest support. Discards itself to search an Atlantis Spell/Trap; comes back from the GY while you control Umi.
Siren Vortex of Atlantis
Newest support. Summoned: mills an Atlantis card; sent to the GY, summons a WATER from the hand.
Monster Arms of Atlantis
Newest support. Summoned: revives an Atlantis monster; banishes itself to negate a monster effect.
Fisherman of Legend
Newest support. Joins when their monster acts or attacks with Umi out, destroys a monster, and returns to the hand.
Coralianectes, the Luminous Cradle Dragon
Generic WATER from the same set: searched, summons itself and another WATER; shields your WATER Links.
Ocean Dragon Lord - Kairyu-Shin
While Umi is on the field, each player keeps only one non-WATER monster; searches Umi or a Kairyu-Shin card.
Electric Jellyfish
Sends an Umi to summon a WATER from the hand; negates with Umi on the field.
Advent of Atlantis
Newest support. Counts as Umi; places Atlantis or Umi from the Deck, and searches a Level 7 Sea Serpent from the GY.
Call of Atlantis
Newest support. Searches an Atlantis monster and negates a monster with Atlantis out.
Atlantis, City of the Sea Dragon
Newest support. Field Spell: lowers Levels, cuts a Daedalus Link's materials by one, and returns from the GY.
A Legendary Ocean
Counts as Umi everywhere; lets Kairyu-Shin and Warchief Normal Summon without a Tribute.
Fish Sonar
Searches any Level 7 or lower monster that mentions Umi, which covers every new monster.
Kairyu-Shin's Dark Reef
Sends an Umi to summon two monsters that mention Umi from the Deck.
Daedalus Maelstrom
Newest support. Counter Trap: negates a summon with Atlantis out, and can clear every non-WATER monster.
Dominus Impulse
Negates a summoning effect, from the hand if needed.
extra: Azure Ocean Dragon Lord - Neo-Daedalus Rage
Newest support. Link-4 (three materials with Atlantis): revives three Atlantis monsters and sends the whole field to the GY except your Umi.
Newest support. Link-3 for WATERs: summons an Atlantis monster from the Deck and resets the opponent's hand.
WATER Link-2: revives Siren Vortex or Monster Arms.
WATER Link-3: negates and halves their monsters; banishes their field when it points to three.
Generic WATER Link-4: resets the field and destroys co-linked cards' worth in battle.
